```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() {
    const tabContainer = document.querySelector(".panel-tabset.nav-pills.nav-fill.flex-column");
    
    if (tabContainer) {
      const nav = tabContainer.querySelector(".nav");
      const tabContent = tabContainer.querySelector(".tab-content");
      
      if (nav && tabContent) {
        // Orden deseado
        const desiredOrder = [
          "Init",
          "AutoReport", 
          "Anova (Class Room)",
          "Rscience Code",
          "R Script",
          "Others"
        ];
        
        // Reordenar pestañas en el nav
        desiredOrder.forEach(function(tabTitle) {
          const navItems = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(".nav-item"));
          const targetItem = navItems.find(item => 
            item.querySelector(".nav-link").textContent.trim() === tabTitle
          );
          if (targetItem) {
            nav.appendChild(targetItem);
          }
        });
        
        // Reordenar contenido de pestañas
        desiredOrder.forEach(function(tabTitle) {
          const tabPanes = Array.from(tabContent.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane"));
          const targetPane = tabPanes.find(pane => {
            const link = document.querySelector(`[href="#${pane.id}"]`);
            return link && link.textContent.trim() === tabTitle;
          });
          if (targetPane) {
            tabContent.appendChild(targetPane);
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }, 200);
});
</script>
')
```
